chunks: And Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Shuʿayb, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
That he was asked about the maʿtūh: is his divorce valid? He said, “What is he?” I said, “The foolish one whose intellect has gone.” He said, “Yes.”

key_terms.الْمَعْتُوهِ: a mentally impaired or feeble-minded person under discussion in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is the divorce of a mentally impaired or foolish person valid in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question addressed to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام regarding whether the divorce pronounced by a maʿtūh is valid. After clarifying that the term refers to a foolish person with impaired reasoning, the Imam عليه السلام rules that such a divorce is valid.
